## The Problem: Budgeting Apps Assume You Get Paid on the 1st

Most budgeting tools were designed for people with salaries. They ask you for your monthly income, divide it into categories, and call it a day.

That doesn't work when your income looks like this:

- $9,200 in March because two projects wrapped at once
- $1,450 in April because a client is "processing" your invoice
- $0 in the first three weeks of May, then $6,000 on the 27th

When money arrives in waves, every month feels like either a feast or a crisis. You overspend after a big payment, panic during the gaps, and then get hit in April with a tax bill you forgot to plan for. Spreadsheets help for a while, until you stop updating them.

Freelancers don't need more categories. They need a system that accounts for uncertainty.

---

## How It Works

### 1. Connect your accounts

Link your business and personal bank accounts in a few minutes. Ledgerly uses read-only connections through a trusted banking provider, so we can see transactions but can never move money without your permission.

### 2. Every payment goes to your "Income Reservoir"

When a client pays you, Ledgerly doesn't treat it as spending money. It sends it into a holding pool we call the Reservoir. From there, we automatically calculate your tax set-aside based on your country, your filing status, and what you've earned so far this year.

### 3. Pay yourself a steady salary

You choose a monthly amount you'd like to live on. Ledgerly shows you how many months of that salary your Reservoir can currently cover. On payday, you transfer that amount to your personal account, just like a regular job. Big month? The extra stays in the Reservoir and protects you later. Slow month? Your salary doesn't change.

### 4. See the runway, not just the balance

The dashboard answers the questions that actually keep you up at night: How many months could I go without a new client? Am I on track for quarterly taxes? Can I afford to take August off? It's all on one screen, updated every time a payment lands.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is my financial data secure?**
Yes. We use bank-level encryption both in transit and at rest, and account connections are read-only. We never sell your data, and you can delete your account and all associated information at any time.

**Does Ledgerly file my taxes?**
No. Ledgerly estimates what you'll owe and helps you set money aside so you're ready. When it's time to file, you can export a clean summary for your accountant or your preferred tax software.

**What if my income is truly unpredictable?**
That's exactly who we built this for. The salary feature works best when you choose a conservative amount at first. As your Reservoir grows, Ledgerly will suggest when it's safe to give yourself a raise.

**Can I use it if I also have a part-time job?**
Absolutely. You can mark any income source as regular or irregular, and Ledgerly will combine them into one clear picture.

**Which countries do you support?**
Ledgerly currently supports bank connections and tax estimates in the US, Canada, the UK, and most of the EU. We're adding more regions every quarter.

**What happens when my trial ends?**
We'll remind you three days before. If you don't choose a plan, your account simply switches to read-only mode, and your data stays safe for 90 days in case you change your mind.
